description: This file defines a React functional component named 'SearchToolView' which renders a detailed view of a search tool, including its metadata, description, and a tester component. It handles copying certain fields to the clipboard, displays provider information, and manages state for copy actions.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: An asynchronous function that copies given text to clipboard and updates UI state to show success feedback.

methods.name: getProviderDisplayName
methods.description: Retrieves a user-friendly name for a provider based on its internal name.
